About Osceola Medical Center:
Since 1932, Osceola Medical Center has provided the St. Croix Valley area of Western Wisconsin and Eastern Minnesota with hometown quality healthcare including primary care, Walk-In Clinic, specialty clinics, hospital, and emergency care. Our team of providers and specialists work together to inspire and improve the health and well-being of our community. For more information about OMC, visit https://myomc.org/.
